messages:
noah kim: alert-bot fired: high backlog on gpu-prod-1 pool (queue > 10k) and eviction spike. paging oncall
alert-bot: Pager: SEV-1 gpu-capacity-exhaustion assigned to @noah kim
pagerduty: Alert details: enqueue_rate=2200r/s service_rate=1200r/s evictions=45/m
isabel rodriguez: i'm here, joining. quick check: autoscaler desired=30, actually provisioned=24. cloud API returning quota=24
tanvi rao: seeing a bunch of kernel Xid messages on node gpu-1-05 and gpu-1-08 around 3543210123
noah kim: tailing syslog from gpu-1-05, attaching excerpt:
```
[3543210119] NVRM: Xid 31, PID 10532
[3543210121] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 10532 (inferenced)
[3543210122] kubelet: Node gpu-1-05 status: NotReady - kernel oom
```
leo chen: provider quota explain: some older projects hit soft limit after nightly cleanup failed; provider returning 403 on create
devops-bot: autoscaler attempted to create 6 nodes; cloud API failed for 4 with quota error
isabel rodriguez: effective healthy nodes = 20 after 4 OOM/node drains. We need 30 -> backlog growth
support: multiple customers reporting 503s; biggest affected is customer "Nimbus" with heavy sampling jobs
noah kim: mitigation plan - phase 1: emergency throttles: reduce batch_size from 32->12 for heavy routes, enforce per-client concurrency=1
isabel rodriguez: applying runtime config now
infra-bot: config update posted: /configs/runtime/batch_sizes -> updated for routes: /v1/sample /v1/batch
tanvi rao: also marked problematic nodes unschedulable and started draining gpu-1-05, gpu-1-08
noah kim: note: some nodes flapping because newer GPU driver (v525) got rolled 3 days ago. dmesg shows driver timeout patterns
leo chen: suggestion: reprovision a couple of nodes with driver v520 from our golden image in separate AZ to avoid quota collision
devops-bot: reprovision job queued: target 2 nodes, parallelism=2, image=golden-v520
pagerduty: escalation: consider cross-region fallback if EU pool saturated
isabel rodriguez: cross-region routing takes 8-12 minutes to warm due to KV cache and shard affinity - doable but customer latency will spike
noah kim: CS comms drafted: "We are experiencing GPU capacity degradation due to node instability and cloud quota limits. Mitigations in progress: throttling heavy requests, draining unstable hosts, reprovisioning nodes to previous driver. Expect gradual improvement over the next 1-3 hours." sending now
support: sent to Nimbus and two other affected customers; Nimbus asks for ETA and workarounds
tanvi rao: workaround: suggest reducing sample_size client-side and adding exponential backoff for retries. Sent suggested config snippet
noah kim: monitoring: queue length peaked 11.2k -> now 7.1k after throttles. Xid count per minute still ~10 on remaining nodes
isabel rodriguez: logs from gpu-1-07 show intermittent Xid 79 errors, temp mapping corruption. I'll isolate that node next
leo chen: provider responded to quota ticket: can grant +10 immediately if we provide justification and confirm rapid cleanup after. Ticket# Q-78910
noah kim: accepted, requesting +10. Meanwhile keep reprovisioning 2 v520 nodes to bring healthy capacity to 22 while we wait
devops-bot: reprovision succeeded: gpu-1-21, gpu-1-22 joined with driver v520
isabel rodriguez: initial validation passed, no Xid observed on new nodes so far
noah kim: queue drain rate improved; currently trending toward full stabilization if provider grants quota and we finish draining two flappers
support: Nimbus accepted temporary degraded SLA and disabled sampling spikes; thanked for proactive comms
infra-bot: incident summary uploaded to doc store; added incident tag: gpu-runtime-xid-quota
pagerduty: Handoff reminder: primary oncall -> leo chen at 3543210600 if no further Xid spikes
noah kim: action items: 1) follow up on provider quota 2) reprovision remaining suspect nodes to v520 3) autoscaler rule: detect repeated Xid and pause scale up in same AZ 4) postmortem when stable
isabel rodriguez: logging note: capture full dmesg for flapped nodes and attach to bug report to driver vendor
noah kim: leaving thread in handoff. staying reachable for any regressions. thanks all :heart:
